GARNET.name: Garnet
GARNET.lore: Two pairs of red facets. Couples love it.

PRISM.name: Prism
PRISM.lore: Splits light into every element at once.

MOONSTONE.name: Moonstone
MOONSTONE.lore: Glows brighter under a full moon, naturally.

OBSIDIAN.name: Obsidian
OBSIDIAN.lore: Black glass from a ritual fire.

EMERALD.name: Emerald
EMERALD.lore: Four perfect facets for four perfect dice.

BLOODSTONE.name: Bloodstone
BLOODSTONE.lore: Pulses like a heartbeat. Not yours.
